# Focused discovery candidate observer evidence

`contract-actor.mjs` is constructed contract evidence, not a native trajectory.
The only native fixture is the exact 52 KiB retained historical actor in
`portable-native-regrasp.json.gz`, with `portable-actor.mjs` restoring undefined,
signed zero, key order and alias metadata. Its compressed SHA256 is
`6a5641fb2fad297beaf6f777965a6aa8b4c6bef2737abfe5ad666603dd5b7773`.
The source capture was the older, rejected v2 runtime, not current main. The
original input/actor/source hashes and capture limitations remain embedded in
its provenance. The fixture contains private engine diagnostics used ONLY by
the detached tests; only the collector's allowlisted report is observational
output. No private save, whole archive or ecology world is copied.

The replay is one zero-time **current-main controller counterfactual on exact
historical v2 input**. It binds the current approved geometry outside actor data,
skips an already-completed sensing pass and invokes the real idle controller
boundary, including authoritative action request, on discarded identical clones.
It does not tick physics, reconstruct private sighting caches, claim a current
main trajectory or establish survival improvement. The test checks the original
capture's narrow learned-source cache equivalence, not general continuation
fidelity. Small fresh-actor comparisons separately exercise ordinary 1/60 ticks.

Baseline parity loads a controller reconstructed only by removing the candidate
capture import, methods, dispose cleanup and seam call. Before importing, its
entire source must match the pinned baseline SHA256. Imports are resolved to the
same production modules. The in-memory module creates no tracked/generated file.

Focused command: `node --test tests/discovery-candidates.test.mjs`.
